title: documents.php upload response
description: 201 for a newly stored PDF, 200 with existing=true when the same bytes were already stored for this patient (the earlier document is reused, and re-pointed if it had been deleted). Rejections (too large, not a PDF) use documents.error.response with a reason.

status.description: stored for a new upload; an existing document keeps its status.

correlation_id.description: Correlation id of the request; quote it when reporting a problem.
